# Requirements Document: Time limits on offers and new order items

## Introduction

An offer expires at an instant, and each offer item may carry time limits of
its own: a price guarantee, an inventory guarantee and a payment time limit.
Before an order exists, no limit outlasts the offer.  When an order is
created, each order item takes its payment time limit and its price guarantee
from its offer item.  The guide leaves three points open, so the model takes
them as parameters: whether a guarantee still holds at the instant it ends,
what happens when an offer is accepted after a price guarantee has lapsed, and
which form of payment time limit applies when an offer item states two.

These requirements are generated from the Lean model in [`Rules/OneOrder/Offers/TimeLimits.lean`](https://github.com/samdengler/verified-air/blob/main/Rules/OneOrder/Offers/TimeLimits.lean). Each acceptance criterion carries the status the build computed for it: *proven* means a theorem the build checked, *example only* means a computed example, *open* means a theorem the build could not prove, and *not checked* means no theorem or example covers it yet.

## Requirements

### Requirement ONE-501

**User Story:** As an airline, I want an offer's guarantees to end when the offer expires, so that I never stand behind a price or a seat for an offer that can no longer be accepted.

**Rule:** WHILE no order has been created from an offer THE SYSTEM SHALL treat an offer item's price and inventory as guaranteed only until both the item's guarantee time limit and the offer's expiry. (Lean: `guaranteesAt`)

#### Acceptance Criteria

1. IF an offer item carries no price guarantee time limit THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL treat its price as not guaranteed.
   - ONE-501.1, proven: proven theorem `no_limit_no_guarantee`; example `guaranteesThroughTheMorning`
2. WHILE an instant is before an offer item's price guarantee time limit and before the offer's expiry THE SYSTEM SHALL treat the item's price as guaranteed.
   - ONE-501.2, proven: proven theorem `price_guaranteed_before`; example `guaranteesThroughTheMorning`
3. WHILE an instant is before an offer item's inventory guarantee time limit and before the offer's expiry THE SYSTEM SHALL treat the item's inventory as guaranteed.
   - ONE-501.3, proven: proven theorem `inventory_guaranteed_before`; example `guaranteesThroughTheMorning`
4. THE SYSTEM SHALL end every price and inventory guarantee of an offer no later than the offer's expiry.
   - ONE-501.4, proven: proven theorem `guarantees_end_by_expiry`; example `guaranteeAfterExpiry`
5. THE SYSTEM SHALL not treat an offer item's price as guaranteed at an instant at which the offer can no longer be accepted.
   - ONE-501.5, open: open theorem `guaranteed_while_acceptable`; counterexample `guaranteeAtExpiry`

#### Open question on ONE-501.5

> An offer item's price is guaranteed only at instants at which the offer can
> still be accepted.
>
> Open question for the business.  The guide says a price is guaranteed until its
> time limit and does not say whether the limit's own instant is inside.  An
> offer is rejected as expired at its expiry instant.  Under the reading that a
> guarantee still holds at its instant, an item whose price guarantee ends at
> the same instant as the offer has a guaranteed price at an instant when the
> offer can no longer be accepted.  The example `guaranteeAtExpiry` shows
> it.  Does a price guarantee still hold at the instant its time limit
> names?

### Requirement ONE-502

**User Story:** As an airline, I want each new order item to start with the payment time limit and price guarantee its offer item promised, so that the customer gets the time to pay and the price the offer stated.

**Rule:** WHEN a customer accepts an offer whose items carry time limits THE SYSTEM SHALL create the order as ONE-001 does and give each order item its payment time limit and price guarantee from its offer item. (Lean: `createOrder`)

#### Acceptance Criteria

1. WHEN an order is created from an offer item whose payment time limit is stated only as a duration THE SYSTEM SHALL set the order item's payment time limit to the creation instant plus that duration.
   - ONE-502.1, proven: proven theorem `createOrder_duration`; example `bothFormsReadings`; example `newOrderLimits`
2. WHEN an order is created from an offer item whose payment time limit is stated only as a fixed date and time THE SYSTEM SHALL set the order item's payment time limit to that instant.
   - ONE-502.2, proven: proven theorem `createOrder_fixed`; example `bothFormsReadings`; example `newOrderLimits`
3. WHEN an order is created THE SYSTEM SHALL carry each offer item's price guarantee time limit into its order item.
   - ONE-502.3, proven: proven theorem `createOrder_keeps_guarantee`; example `newOrderLimits`
4. IF a customer accepts an offer after the price guarantee of one of its items has lapsed THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL not create the order at the offered price.
   - ONE-502.4, open: open theorem `createOrder_price_guaranteed`; counterexample `lapsedGuaranteeAccepted`
5. WHEN an order is created THE SYSTEM SHALL give no order item a payment time limit before the order's creation.
   - ONE-502.5, open: open theorem `createOrder_limit_not_before_creation`; counterexample `fixedLimitBeforeCreation`
6. WHEN an offer item's payment time limit is a duration of zero THE SYSTEM SHALL accept a payment for its order item made at the instant the order is created.
   - ONE-502.6, open: open theorem `zero_duration_payable`; counterexample `zeroDurationPayment`

#### Open question on ONE-502.4

> No order is created at the offered price while the price guarantee of one
> of the offer's items has lapsed.
>
> Open question for the business.  The guide recommends repricing into a new
> offer when a price guarantee has lapsed, and does not say what the airline
> must do when the customer accepts the offer before it expires.  Under the
> reading that creates the order at the offered price, an offer whose
> 30 minute price guarantee lapsed is accepted at the offered price one minute
> before the offer expires.  The example `lapsedGuaranteeAccepted` shows
> it.  Is acceptance in this window refused, sent back for a new offer, or
> honoured at the offered price?

#### Open question on ONE-502.5

> No order item starts with a payment time limit before the order's
> creation.
>
> Open question for the business.  An offer item may state its payment time limit
> as a fixed date and time, and the guide does not say what happens when that
> instant has passed by the time the order is created.  The rule copies the
> instant, so the order item is overdue the moment it exists.  The example
> `fixedLimitBeforeCreation` shows it.  Is such an acceptance refused, or
> does the order item get a new payment time limit?

#### Open question on ONE-502.6

> An order item whose offer item's payment time limit is a duration of zero
> can be paid at the instant the order is created.
>
> Open question for the business.  The guide says a payment time limit of zero
> means payment is due at order creation.  The rule sets the order item's limit
> to the creation instant, and the payment rule of ONE-304 rejects a payment
> made at or after the limit, so no payment for the item is ever on time.  The
> example `zeroDurationPayment` shows it.  Is a payment made at the
> creation instant on time, or must it come with the request that creates the
> order?
